config.description: M1 v1.1 real-device config for DEV112P 1dfft recordings (pilot: T01/P01/R01, 5.168 Hz, region [1,3] signal-calibrated, main_bin 2). Data-driven recalibration from the 2026-11-12 field recording, second pass after first replay exposed the EMA-absorption coupling: while presence=0 the background EMA (alpha=0.2) absorbs a static entrant with time constant ~1 s, so hysteresis_confirm_frames MUST stay ~1x that constant (synthetic confirm=5 at 5 Hz obeys the same constraint). Anchors therefore use adapting-bg transient semantics (probe B: empty P90 26.3 dB, entry/posture transients 33-48 dB), not frozen-bg semantics; once presence=1 freezes the bg the occupied residual naturally saturates f1n. F1 remains the only discriminating feature on this hardware; F2/F3 serve as hold-on micro-motion evidence because environmental low-frequency phase disturbance (~0.2-0.5 Hz) occupies the breathing band even when empty. f3_denominator=non_static excludes the DC bin (60+ dB static-to-modulation ratio structurally zeroes total-denominator F3). Known limitations documented in outputs/t01-p01/verification_report.md: drift-defeated release possible on long recordings; static gate inert (environment disturbance inflates f23 even when empty).
config.background_rationale: alpha=0.02 (tau ~9.7 s at 5.168 Hz) is required by the confirm-vs-absorption race: with alpha=0.2 the entrant is absorbed -11.7 dB within the 6-frame confirm window and a still occupant cannot confirm; alpha=0.02 loses only ~1.1 dB over the same window. Synthetic G1 implicitly obeys the same constraint (confirm=5 ~= 1 s ~= 1x tau).
config.target_count_policy: 1 when presence=1 (single-seat region assumption, documented), 0 when empty, -1 when unknown

region_params.note: Nominal installation values from project plan 5.2 (24-24.25 GHz sweep -> 0.6 m resolution). Replace with measured values after real installation. Coarse-granularity risk documented: plan A region spans only ~3-4 bins.
region_params.bin_conversion: bin_lo = floor(region_m[0] / range_resolution_m); bin_hi = ceil(region_m[1] / range_resolution_m); clip to [0, n_range_bins-1]
